turns.content: Okay so ugh this is lowkey driving me nuts lol. I have this tiny $85 payout from cat-sitting that was supposed to direct deposit four days ago and nothing happened. I think I submitted the wrong voided check form on day one and now I'm paranoid Chloe is lowkey punishing me for it??? But it's literally just pocket money so I refuse to make a scene. Can you draft me a quick friendly two-sentence text to Chloe just checking on the status? Nothing formal or confrontational at all, just breezy.

Hey Chloe, just checking on the $85 cat-sitting payment—I haven’t seen it come through yet, any update? I might’ve sent the wrong direct-deposit form, so let me know if you need me to resend anything!

Omg that is SO perfect thank you!! Short, breezy, mentions the form without groveling… you nailed it ✨

Okay so here's the thing though… do you think I should send it now or wait until Monday?? Part of me is like "just get it over with" but another part is scared it'll seem pushy 😂

The payment is already four days overdue by your account, so a brief status check is reasonable. Nothing you’ve described establishes that Chloe is punishing you or that a check-in would be pushy.

Send it now if it’s a normal daytime hour; otherwise, schedule it for Monday morning.

Yeah okay that makes sense… lol you're probably right that I'm overthinking the Chloe thing. It's just like why would she ghost my deposit over a wrong form?? Ugh whatever.

I'll send it now then! Thanks for talking me down haha 😅
Send the text as written; it asks for an update without assuming why the payment is late.
Okay I sent it!! (nervous lol) But now I'm spiraling again... what if she sees the text and is like "wow this girl is so impatient"?? It's literally $85 and I'm stressing like it's rent money 😩

You sent one friendly check-in about a payment you report is four days late. That doesn’t establish impatience, and we don’t know what Chloe thinks. The $85 amount doesn’t change whether you can ask about its status.

Leave it there for now and give her two business days to reply before following up.
You know what, you're right lol. Two business days is totally reasonable. I just get in my head about dumb stuff like this. Thanks for being the voice of reason here 😅
The status is still unknown; you’ve asked for an update. Stick with the two-business-day wait before following up.
